title: PM/Eng 1:1 prep - Sam Jensen
content:
Meeting: PM (Sam Jensen) + Eng Lead (Noah Kim) 1:1 - prep notes
Date: 2026-03-03 (weekly)
Goal: align on priorities across Hosted API, Console, Dedicated, Private; unblock key infra/QA items; check rollout readiness for console changes and Dedicated autoscaling work.

Top-level items to cover
- Console rollout (beta -> staged rollout): readiness checklist, canary metrics, rollback plan.
- Dedicated autoscaling: current SLA risk window and capacity forecasting for March commitments.
- Private deployment onboarding: first two PoCs (healthcare customer) and KMS integration status.
- API regressions: small uptick in 95th p50 latencies for small seq len; triage status and mitigation options.

Quick updates (what I expect / sanity check)
- Console: UX sign-off from Design (Priya) - done; telemetry hooks still pending (GH #512) - need engineering ETA.
- Dedicated autoscale: infra has a PR for scale-down bug (INF-2345) in staging, but failing integration tests. Noah: what's the blocker?
- Private: deployment artifacts for on-prem package are ready; security/Legal still needs to sign off on data residency docs.
- API perf: perf team pushed hotfix for attention kernel (INF-2410) - early A/B looks ok but need broader sampling next week.

Discussion prompts / questions for Noah
1) Console telemetry: can we get the server-side tracing + per-route cost breakdown hooked into the canary by EOD Friday? If not, propose graceful fallback: enable client-side metrics and soft-launch with tight error budget.
2) Autoscale rollbacks: what are the acceptable thresholds to trigger auto rollback? current heuristics are too sensitive (timeouts on scale down). Can we add a 5-min stable window and a soft cap to avoid flapping?
3) Private onboarding: who owns the KMS integration details for the HC customer? We need an owner to coordinate with security and the customer's infra lead.
4) API perf regression: if the attention kernel fix shows a 7-10% improvement in p95 but increases cpu on host by ~6%, do we accept for hosted customers or gate behind Dedicated only?

Notes to self / agenda order
- 5m quick wins and shoutouts (ship metrics for last sprint).
- 10m Console status + rollout gating decisions.
- 10m Dedicated autoscale + capacity forecasts for next 6 weeks.
- 10m Private onboarding + security signoffs.
- 5m AOB / action items.

Relevant metrics to pull before meeting
- Console beta canary: error rate, latency, RU (requests/user) - last 48h.
- Dedicated cluster utilization: GPU utilization by pool, pending queue length, autoscale event log (last 7 days).
- API perf: p50/p95/p99 for token generation across seq_len buckets (8/64/512).
- Cost delta A/B for attention kernel hotfix (sample customers).

Open blockers (short notes)
- INF-2345 (autoscale integration tests failing): failing in autoscaler when multiple pods scale down concurrently - root cause looks like race in cache eviction. Need eng lead to prioritize test fix + coordination with infra.
  Owner: Noah. Target: 2026-03-05 for green CI.
- GH #512 Console telemetry: backend hooks missing for per-route cost; blocks canary metric gating.
  Owner: Priya (design) + Eng (Noah to assign). Target: 2026-03-06 to have minimal telemetry.
- Legal signoff for Private on-prem package (data residency/cust contracts): blocker for HC customer kickoff.
  Owner: Isabel Torres (Customer Success) + Legal. Target: 2026-03-10 to get redlines.

Potential decisions we might need to make during meeting
- Do we delay canary until backend telemetry is ready or proceed with client-only telemetry? (Risk: less signal -> slower detection)
- Do we enable the attention kernel hotfix for Hosted immediately or roll it into Dedicated-only profile first?
- If autoscale fix misses Friday target, do we freeze Dedicated feature releases until next deploy window?

Follow-ups / Action items (post-1:1) - draft that we can confirm in meeting
- Noah: prioritize INF-2345 test fix; post a short ETA in #eng-infra and update the ticket. (due 2026-03-05)
- Priya + Noah: minimal backend telemetry PR for console canary (GH #512) - target small schema: per-route latency, errors, tokens. (due 2026-03-06)
- Sam (me): draft customer-facing note for HC PoC kickoff outlining what we need from their infra (KMS, network, contact) and share with Isabel/legal. (due 2026-03-04)
- Isabel: chase Legal for contract redlines and confirm any export controls or residency clauses. (due 2026-03-10)
- Perf team (cc Noah): run broader A/B for attention kernel fix across 10k sample requests and share cost/perf table. (due 2026-03-06)

Notes for meeting follow-up doc (what to save)
- Record decisions + thresholds for autoscale rollback.
- Attach canary metric snapshots and GH/PR links.
- List owners & deadlines (as above).

Quick rough script (how I'll open)
"Quick status sync - biggest risk for launch is telemetry for console and autoscale flakiness. Would like to make two decisions today: (1) whether console canary can proceed with client-only telemetry if backend isn't ready, and (2) whether the attention kernel hotfix should go to hosted. If we can close those, we should be OK to keep the March rollout timelines."

Scratchpad / ideas (riffing)
- Could we add a lightweight server-side metric forwarder in the console agent that batches per-route counts to reduce telemetry work? Small infra piece but could buy time.
- Autoscale: consider a backoff window that increases with number of consecutive scale-downs to avoid thrash.

Slack links / refs
- #eng-api thread: "perf kernel A/B" (pinned)
- #eng-infra: INF-2345 discussion thread
- Confluence: console rollout page (linked above)

Misc personal notes
- Remind myself to ask Noah if he's got bandwidth to pair on the staging run Monday AM - would help unblock canary validation.
- Bring up ramp plan for Dedicated customers (pricing + docs) next week with Product Ops.
